python.name: Python Programming
python.project_idea: Build a small CLI tool (e.g. a to-do list or unit converter) to practice core syntax.

math.name: Mathematics (Linear Algebra, Calculus)
math.project_idea: Implement matrix operations (add, multiply, transpose) from scratch without NumPy.

statistics.name: Statistics & Probability
statistics.project_idea: Analyze a public dataset (e.g. from Kaggle) and report mean, variance, and key distributions.

data_analysis.name: Data Analysis (Pandas, NumPy)
data_analysis.project_idea: Clean and explore a messy real-world CSV dataset using Pandas; produce a short EDA report.

ml_basics.name: Machine Learning Basics
ml_basics.project_idea: Train a simple classifier (e.g. Iris dataset) using scikit-learn and evaluate its accuracy.

ml_project.name: First ML Project (Regression/Classification)
ml_project.project_idea: Build an end-to-end prediction project (e.g. house price prediction) with a written report.

deep_learning.name: Deep Learning Fundamentals
deep_learning.project_idea: Build a simple feedforward neural network from scratch (no framework) on a toy dataset.

pytorch.name: PyTorch / TensorFlow
pytorch.project_idea: Re-implement your deep learning project using PyTorch or TensorFlow instead of from scratch.

cnn_project.name: Build a CNN Project
cnn_project.project_idea: Build an image classifier (e.g. cats vs dogs) using a CNN architecture.

computer_vision.name: Computer Vision
computer_vision.project_idea: Build an object detection or face-detection demo using OpenCV + a pretrained model.

nlp.name: Natural Language Processing
nlp.project_idea: Build a text classifier (e.g. sentiment analysis) using a pretrained transformer model.

reinforcement_learning.name: Reinforcement Learning
reinforcement_learning.project_idea: Train an RL agent to solve a simple environment (e.g. CartPole with OpenAI Gym).

robotics_control.name: Robotics: Control Systems & ROS
robotics_control.project_idea: Simulate a basic robot arm or mobile robot control loop using ROS or a simulator like Gazebo.

research_methods.name: Research Methods & Reading Papers
research_methods.project_idea: Read and summarize 2-3 papers in your area of interest; write a one-page critical review.
